name: Famine
body:
Type curse; Save Will DC 22 negates, Fortitude DC 22 to avoid effects

Effect

Any food that the target attempts to consume instantly rots into a putrescent mass. The target can attempt a Fortitude save to choke down the spoiled food. If the target fails at the check, she takes 1d2 points of Constitution damage. In either case, attempting to consume food leaves the target sickened and unable to eat for 1d4 hours. Food created by magic can resist spoilage with a successful caster level check against the DC of the curse.
